name: cursor-agent
description: The Cursor Agent CLI inside VS Code: streaming chat, tool calls, diffs, permissions, sessions.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The Cursor agent runs commands and edits files in the workspace.

virtualWorkspaces.description: The Cursor agent needs a real folder on disk.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Cursor Agent
walkthroughs.description: Chat with the Cursor Agent CLI inside VS Code.

steps.title: Install the Cursor Agent CLI
steps.description:
Install the CLI and sign in once from a terminal.
[Install instructions](https://cursor.com/docs/cli/installation)
```bash
curl https://cursor.com/install -fsS | bash
agent login
```

steps.title: Point the extension at the CLI
steps.description:
By default the extension looks for `agent` on your PATH. If you use a wrapper script (for example to select an account), set the path in Settings.
[Open Settings](command:cursorAcp.openSettings?%5B%22agent%22%5D)

steps.title: Start chatting
steps.description:
Open the Cursor Agent view and send a message. Press Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line, and type / for commands.
[Open Cursor Agent](command:cursorAcp.focus)

cursorAcp.agentPath.markdownDescription: Path to the Cursor Agent CLI executable (or a wrapper script) that supports `acp`. Leave empty to auto-detect `cursor-agent` (then `agent`) from PATH, your login shell and common install directories; a configured value is always used instead. The extension runs `<agentPath> [agentArgs...] acp`. Example: `/Users/me/.local/bin/cursor-flexnet`. Resolved on the machine that hosts the workspace (the remote host when using Remote SSH).

cursorAcp.agentPathWindows.markdownDescription: Agent path used only when VS Code's extension host runs on Windows itself. WSL and remote windows ignore this and use `cursorAcp.agentPath`. Leave empty to auto-detect `agent.exe` / `agent.cmd` from PATH and `%LOCALAPPDATA%\cursor-agent`.

cursorAcp.agentArgs.markdownDescription: Extra arguments passed to the executable **before** `acp` (for example `["-e", "https://api2.cursor.sh"]`).

cursorAcp.environment.markdownDescription: Extra environment variables for the agent process. Values override the extension host environment.

cursorAcp.configDir.markdownDescription: Cursor CLI config directory containing `auth.json` (used only for the usage panel). Leave empty to auto-detect from `CURSOR_CONFIG_DIR`, a wrapper script that exports it, or `~/.cursor`.

cursorAcp.mcpForwardProjectServers.markdownDescription: Pass the servers in this workspace's `.cursor/mcp.json` to the agent with each session. In ACP mode the Cursor CLI silently skips project servers that have not been approved in the terminal app; forwarding them bypasses that step, so it is skipped in untrusted workspaces.

cursorAcp.mcpUserConfig.markdownDescription: The user-level `mcp.json` this profile's agent reads (`.cursor/mcp.json` under the agent's home folder), shown on the MCP servers page for reference. The agent loads it itself, with the sign-ins it saved, so the extension does not forward it. Cursor plugin servers only reach chat when listed there under their plugin name, e.g. `plugin-sentry-sentry`.

cursorAcp.editorTitleButton.markdownDescription: Show a Cursor Agent button in the editor title bar for quick access to the chat.

cursorAcp.resumeLastSession.markdownDescription: Automatically resume the last session for this workspace when the chat opens.

cursorAcp.sendWithCtrlEnter.markdownDescription: Use Ctrl/Cmd+Enter to send instead of Enter (Enter then inserts a newline).

cursorAcp.showThoughts.markdownDescription: Show the agent's thinking/reasoning blocks in the transcript.

cursorAcp.notifyWhenHidden.markdownDescription: Show a VS Code notification when the agent needs permission or finishes a turn while the chat view is not visible.

cursorAcp.protocolLogging.markdownDescription: Log every ACP JSON-RPC message to the *Cursor Agent* output channel (useful for debugging).

enumDescriptions: Prompt for every command and tool call.
Run read-only commands and tools from the safe list without asking; prompt for the rest.
cursorAcp.approvalPolicy.markdownDescription: Default approval policy for new sessions. Can be changed per session from the chat toolbar. Nothing is written to Cursor's own permission config.

cursorAcp.safeList.markdownDescription: Regular expressions for the *Safe list* policy. Each is tested against every segment of a shell command (split on `|`, `&&`, `||`, `;`), and against Cursor's permission pattern for tools, e.g. `Mcp(server:tool)`. Commands using redirection, command substitution or an inline shell always prompt.

cursorAcp.hiddenModels.markdownDescription: Model ids hidden from the model picker. New models Cursor adds stay visible until hidden. Managed from *Manage models…* at the bottom of the picker.

cursorAcp.defaultModel.markdownDescription: Model for new sessions (a model id from the picker). Empty uses whatever the Cursor CLI currently defaults to. Changing the model inside a session only affects that session; use *Set as default* in the model picker to update this.

cursorAcp.defaultModelOptions.markdownDescription: Per-model option values applied to new sessions, keyed by option id, e.g. `{ "effort": "high" }`. Cursor's CLI stores these globally, so the extension re-applies them for every new session and remembers each session's own values on resume.

scripts.package: npm run build && mkdir -p build && vsce package --no-dependencies --out build/
